name: completeness_benchmark
description: A benchmark that evaluates models' ability to produce complete, coherent continuations from partially provided inputs. Tasks present incomplete passages or prompts and measure how well models recover missing content in terms of fidelity, coverage, and fluency. The benchmark is intended to test semantic completion and coherence rather than surface-level token prediction.
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside niche completion evaluation experiments.
